nodes.summary: The pair count is the zero-padded autocorrelation of the cell occupancy counts.
nodes.title: Pair count as autocorrelation of cell occupancy counts

nodes.summary: Zero-padded circular autocorrelation equals the linear one: if `U k = 0` for `k ≥ K`, `2 K ≤ N + 1` and `j < K`, then `𝓕⁻(|𝓕 Ũ|^2)(j) = ∑_{k < K} U k U (k + j)`.
nodes.title: Zero-padded circular autocorrelation equals linear autocorrelation

nodes.summary: The transform computation of the lag-`j` autocorrelation: the inverse discrete Fourier transform of the power spectrum `|𝓕 Ũ|^2` of the zero-padded sequence, read at `j`.
nodes.title: Autocorrelation via the discrete Fourier transform

nodes.summary: The brute-force weighted-LD sum at cell offset `j`: `∑_{x, y : c y = c x + j} ẑ(x, y) w(x) w(y)`, costing a pass over all pairs.
nodes.title: Brute-force weighted linkage disequilibrium sum

nodes.summary: The total `U k = ∑_{x : c x = k} u x` of a per-SNP quantity `u` over grid cell `k`.
nodes.title: Total of a per-SNP quantity over a grid cell

nodes.summary: The centred weighted genotype `(g i x - ḡ x) w x` of individual `i` at SNP `x`.
nodes.title: Centred weighted genotype

nodes.summary: The transform algorithm computes the brute-force weighted-LD sum exactly, for every lag `j < K`, when all SNPs lie in cells `c x < K` and the transform length satisfies `2 K ≤ N + 1`.
nodes.title: ALDER's transform algorithm equals the brute-force weighted LD

nodes.summary: ALDER's transform algorithm: for each individual, the zero-padded autocorrelation of the cell totals of its centred weighted genotypes, computed through `𝓕`; summed over individuals and divided by `m - 1`.
nodes.title: ALDER's Fourier-transform weighted LD computation

nodes.summary: The sample mean genotype `ḡ(x) = (1/m) ∑ i, g i x` at SNP `x` over `m` individuals.
nodes.title: Sample mean genotype at a SNP

nodes.summary: Zero padding: the sequence `U` read on `ZMod N` through `k ↦ U k.val`. When `U` vanishes from `K` on and `K ≤ N`, this is `U` followed by `N - K` zeros.
nodes.title: Zero padding of a sequence to $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: The number of ordered SNP pairs at cell offset `j`, by which ALDER divides the weighted sum.
nodes.title: Number of SNP pairs at a cell offset

nodes.summary: Grouping pairs by cell offset: if every SNP lies in a cell `c x < K`, the pair sum at offset `j` is the lag-`j` cross-correlation of the cell totals.
nodes.title: Pair sum as cross-correlation of cell totals

nodes.summary: The brute-force sum `∑_{x, y : c y = c x + j} u x v y` over ordered SNP pairs whose grid cells differ by `j`.
nodes.title: Brute-force pair sum at a cell offset

nodes.summary: The unbiased sample covariance `ẑ(x, y) = (1/(m - 1)) ∑ i, (g i x - ḡ x) (g i y - ḡ y)` of the genotypes at SNPs `x` and `y` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 5; meaningful for `m ≥ 2`).
nodes.title: Unbiased sample covariance of genotypes

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
